title: Length of a Query Along a Run
statement: Let $N$ be an oracle nondeterministic Turing machine, let $O$ be an oracle language, let $x$ be an input word, and let $w$ be a finite binary choice word. If a word $z$ occurs among the queries made along the run of $N$ with oracle $O$ on input $x$ under $w$, then the length of $z$ is at most the length of $w$.
hypotheses_covered: An oracle nondeterministic machine $N$ with $k$ ordinary work tapes
A word $z$ occurring among the queries along that run
